source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: validateFileName returns a transformed string using the same replacements on every platform, an exact case-insensitive reserved-name list, trimming and the space preference. It does not split extensions. GenerateValidFilename sanitizes its basename before concatenating the extension, and the main/search drag callers add .eml after collision handling. Whole-filename validation and a mimeService replacement were deferred. This contract does not establish every filesystem naming rule.
title: validateFileName transforms basenames before callers append an extension
